description.detail: The project moved to a new extract and a core-only ledger, recorded as revision 98758c1bbe8be51e. Four core suites run (audit, pruning, QA, link prediction); the explainability suite was retired, and the revision message records that change without a finding.
description.numbers: 9,519 nodes; 37,325 edges; 46,844 evidence rows; 1,920 diseases; 2,415 PPI; 3,035 GO terms; 11,384 target-disease pairs; 635 targets; revision 98758c1bbe8be51e; 4/4 suites
